title: Prototype for bypassing tagpdf structure-key parsing on a single tag key, N=1,000

method.compilation: one direct tagged pass per variant from identical populated .aux/.toc seeds
method.variant: For __tag/struct keys containing only one tag=<value> key, call the existing tag/struct/tag socket directly; all other key lists use the saved keys_set:nn implementation.
method.instrumentation: Lua os.clock timers around tagpdf structure, marked-content and annotation routines; the instrumented runs are diagnostic and both carry equivalent timers.

limits: One run per variant; the 2.28-second wall-time difference is not replicated and is too small to separate confidently from run-to-run variation.
Timer wrapper overhead was not separately calibrated; the direct passes are instrumented rather than production builds.
The PDF audit verifies the candidate against the converged control, not binary identity.
decision: The candidate preserves the audited PDF semantics and routes 65,367 of 128,031 calls through the same tagpdf socket. Its one-run timing is 2.28 seconds (1.07%) lower, while the nested parser profile attributes only about 2.22 seconds net difference after the socket cost. This is not enough replicated evidence to retain a global keys_set:nn override in production; reject the prototype and continue profiling other structure-creation work.
